title: Aggregate Functions: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
description: Perform statistical calculations across multiple table rows.

blocks.content:
Aggregate functions summarize data into a single value:

- `COUNT(*)` — total number of rows.
- `SUM(col)` — sum of numeric values.
- `AVG(col)` — average value.
- `MIN(col)` / `MAX(col)` — smallest / largest value.

Aggregate functions turn many rows into one answer. `COUNT` counts, `SUM` adds, `AVG` finds an average, and `MIN` or `MAX` finds an edge.

They answer questions such as “How many orders?” rather than showing each order. Missing values can affect some calculations, so check the data.

blocks.starterCode: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale FROM sales;
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount REAL);

blocks.prompt: Calculate the total (`SUM`) and average (`AVG`) salary of all employees. Return `total_salary` and `avg_salary`.
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary REAL);
blocks.answer_sql: SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_salary, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees;
